name: Bartleby's Mug
summary: Bartleby's Mug is the concluding task in a young Stormwind warrior's initial test of grit. Having bested the belligerent brawler Bartleby in the Pig and Whistle Tavern, the adventurer claims his drinking mug as proof of victory for their trainer, Harry Burlguard.

sections.title: Trophy of a Tavern Brawl
sections.body: Warrior trainers in Stormwind care little for dainty theory; they want to see raw determination and the ability to hold one's ground. Harry Burlguard tasks budding warriors with taking down Bartleby, a stubborn drunk at the bar of the Pig and Whistle in Old Town. Once subdued, Bartleby reluctantly surrenders his prized drinking mug—only after taking one final swig to drain whatever dregs remained.

sections.title: A Step Toward Mastery
sections.body: Delivering the mug back to Harry Burlguard marks the completion of the novice trial. Recognizing the fighter's knack for persuasion through sheer force, Burlguard acknowledges the warrior's readiness for defensive mastery, directing them onward to further battlefield instruction and the seasoned veteran Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why does Harry Burlguard want Bartleby's mug?
faq.answer: The mug serves as undeniable proof that the novice warrior actually fought and bested Bartleby. Bartleby is fiercely attached to his drink, so surrendering his personal mug proves he was soundly beaten into submission.

Bartleby is an unruly tavern patron lingering at the bar of the Pig and Whistle in Stormwind's Old Town. Known for his drunkenness and foul temper, local warrior trainers use him as an informal rite of passage for up-and-coming fighters.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The brawl occurs inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern, situated in Old Town in Stormwind City.

faq.q: What comes after returning the mug to Burlguard?
faq.answer: Once Burlguard inspects the mug and confirms your victory, he imparts advanced training in defensive combat stances before sending you outside the city gates to seek out Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Does Bartleby get hurt permanently in the brawl?
faq.answer: No. The brawl is merely a non-lethal tavern scuffle. Once beaten, Bartleby yields, finishes off his drink, hands over his mug, and remains in the tavern to nurse his bruises and pride.

faq.q: Can any Alliance class do this quest?
faq.answer: This task is strictly reserved for Alliance warriors as part of their level 10 class training progression to master the art of combat stances and defensive maneuvers.

angles.text: Stormwind's trainers believe practical brawling teaches lessons no manual can match; taking Bartleby's mug proves your ability to stand toe-to-toe and overpower unruly foes.
Keeping the peace in Old Town often means handling disorderly patrons, making Bartleby a familiar local headache for Stormwind's martial instructors.
